title: Orthodontic Rider Credit Monthly Amount by Payment Arrangement — Premium Billing Accounts
content:
For the credit on an ended Orthodontic Benefit Riders rider funded by a Premium Billing Accounts arrangement, the monthly amount credited follows how the rider was billed. Read in order; the first tier that holds decides.

**Tier 1 — billed on AutoPay.** The rider months were billed on AutoPay when the account's arrangement either carries an AutoPay discount (only Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly, at 1.00 a month) or does not accept bank draft (EFT) and the account collected regular automatic bank drafts within twelve months before the credit date — drafts only the AutoPay arrangement the account has since left could have collected. The monthly amount is the rider premium less a share of the AutoPay arrangement's monthly discount of 1.00, that share being 1.00 divided equally among the plan units the account bills: two plan units for its dental and vision plans, plus one for each active orthodontic rider.

**Tier 2 — billed at the prepay discount.** When the arrangement carries a prepay discount (only Cascade Individual Annual Prepay, at 4 percent) and has issued a twelve-month invoice within twelve months before the credit date, the monthly amount is the rider premium reduced by the prepay discount percentage.

**Tier 3 — otherwise,** the monthly amount is the rider premium.

The rider premium is the ended rider's plan's monthly premium per covered person. A record falls within twelve months before the credit date when the whole calendar months from its date to the credit date are fewer than 12. Whole calendar months are counted the way an anniversary is counted (a month is complete only when a later month reaches the same day number, and the last day of a shorter month does not complete it). The monthly amount is carried unrounded into the credit.

**Hypothetical illustrations** (rider premium 27.35).
| Account | Active riders still funded | Monthly amount |
|---|---|---|
| Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly | 0 | 27.35 less 0.50: 26.85 |
| Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly | 2 | 27.35 less 0.25: 27.10 |
| Cascade Individual Annual Prepay, twelve-month invoice seven months ago | — | 27.35 less 4 percent: 26.256 |
| Cascade Individual Quarterly Bill (accepts EFT) | — | 27.35 |
